title: Plan E: AI Writing Workflow (Long-form / Marketing)
summary: Topic & positioning → outline → section-by-section draft → human polish & fact-check → visuals & layout → multi-platform publish
scenario: Best for WeChat long-form, SEO articles, marketing copy and industry reports — a quality piece in 30-60 minutes.

steps.title: Topic and positioning
steps.detail: Define the reader, goal and platform, brainstorm topics with an LLM, and deconstruct 1-2 reference pieces for angle and structure. Positioning decides half the reach.
steps.tips: Topic formula: target reader + specific pain + counterintuitive hook beats generic 'tips sharing'.

steps.title: Outline and structure
steps.detail: Have the model build a pyramid (conclusion first) or four-part (hook → problem → solution → CTA) outline, each section annotated with key points, data and visual ideas. Approve the outline before writing.
steps.tips: Lock the outline first to halve rework; leave data/case slots to fill in one by one.

steps.title: Draft section by section
steps.detail: Generate one section per prompt (controlling tone, length and bullet usage). Avoid generating the whole piece at once — section-by-section drafts are structurally steadier and less robotic.
steps.tips: Give the model a sample paragraph (few-shot) to dramatically improve style consistency.

steps.title: Human polish and fact-check
steps.detail: Verify every number, quote and 'according to a study' claim (AI fabricates sources); rewrite conversationally, cut redundancy, add transitions. This is the line between machine output and human work — never skip it.
steps.tips: Check numbers and proper nouns one by one; anything like '20% of users' must trace to a source.

steps.title: Visuals and layout
steps.detail: Cover image plus one visual per section; graded headings, short paragraphs and whitespace. Layout decides read-through rate and is easier to neglect than the prose.
steps.tips: 16:9 cover; keep all visuals in one style and palette to avoid a patchwork feel.

steps.title: Publish and iterate
steps.detail: Adapt titles and openings per platform, then track reads, read-through and saves to refine topics and style for the next piece.
steps.tips: Post the same content with 2-3 titles and see which gets the clicks.

pitfalls.title: Ship the AI draft as-is
pitfalls.detail: It reads robotic and generic; readers can tell. You must polish and add your own examples and judgment.

pitfalls.title: Unverified data and quotes
pitfalls.detail: AI fabricates 'according to a study' and '20% of users'. Verify every claim — credibility is on the line.

pitfalls.title: Generating the whole piece at once
pitfalls.detail: 3000 words in one pass is unstable; section-by-section generation keeps structure controllable.

pitfalls.title: Clickbait and overpromising
pitfalls.detail: Overhyped titles lower trust and read-through; the body must match the headline's promise.
